summary: Territory of Norfolk Island. Administered as an overseas territory of australia.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor General of the Commonwealth of Australia General Sam MOSTYN (since 1 July 2024); Administrator George PLANT (since 1 June 2023)
